entities.summary: 2011 Uprising and Peninsula Shield Intervention, a transformative movement in Bahrain (2011–2015). Emerged from Saudi-led Peninsula Shield forces enter Bahrain to quell protests and Mass protests at Pearl Roundabout demanding constitutional monarchy. Catalyzed Abraham Accord and Post-Uprising Bahrain and Normalization.
